answer: Audits are recorded in vault, queued in saffron, and dune publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 51 identities per epoch. A farm of 242 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4124 identities would post 1443 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
